remarks: Welcome to this beautiful move-in ready ranch. The open floor plan features vaulted ceilings with skylights for incredible natural light, and a stunning two-sided gas fireplace that creates warmth in both the living room and den/office room. The side room is so flexible for a formal dining, familyroom, craft area or work out space and leads to the deck. Pocket doors add privacy to both bedroom "suites". The kitchen has incredible hardware and backsplash - almost modern farmhouse inspired. It is fully applianced and features granite countertops, a stainless farmhouse sink, breakfast bar, and abundant cabinetry. All appliances convey, including the refrigerator, oven/range, microwave, dishwasher, disposal, washer,(new) & dryer(new). Both bedrooms are generously sized and each enjoys access to a full bath.The front bedroom offers exceptional closet space, while the spacious rear primary suite features linen closet, bathroom closet & walk in closet and is overlooking the private backyard. Convenient first-floor laundry includes abundant workspace and storage. Step outside to a private deck overlooking open green space providing the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining.
